auth.notConfigured: The server is not configured, so you can't sign in yet. See README to connect Supabase and PowerSync.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.signUpIntro: Owners create an account and then their organization. Staff: use the email address your manager invited.
auth.confirmEmailSent: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.
auth.resetIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
auth.linkExpired: That link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

validation.minAboveMax: Must be at least the minimum.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
validation.sameTimes: Start and end can't be the same. Turn on "All day" instead.

errors.not_allowed: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member of the organization.
errors.already_invited: Someone else already invited this person. Ask the owner.
errors.invalid_branch: That branch doesn't belong to this organization.
errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation was not found. It may have been withdrawn.
errors.invitation_used: This invitation has already been used.
errors.invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email address first (check your inbox).
errors.last_owner: An organization needs at least one owner. Make someone else owner first.
errors.invalid_station_type: That station type doesn't belong to this organization.
errors.email_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.weak_password: This password is too weak. Choose a longer one.
errors.same_password: The new password must be different from the old one.
errors.otp_expired: That link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: No connection to the server. This needs internet.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

roleDescriptions.owner: Everything, in every branch: settings, prices, staff and all reports.
roleDescriptions.manager: Runs their branches: stations, sessions, expenses, branch reports and cashiers.
roleDescriptions.cashier: Sessions, reservations and payments in their branches. No prices or income reports.

onboarding.intro: You're signed in as {{email}}. Join your team's organization or create your own.
onboarding.createIntro: For owners: your gaming center, with its first branch. You can add more branches later.

boot.waitingForConnection: Waiting for internet. The first sign-in on a device needs a connection; after that the app works offline.

home.noBranch: You're not assigned to any branch yet. Ask your manager or the owner.
home.floorComingSoon: Stations and sessions will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountHint: Your name, password, language, sign out
settings.stationsHint: PCs and rooms in this branch, maintenance
settings.stationTypesHint: PC desk and PlayStation room types, prices, packages
settings.pricePreviewHint: Check what a session would cost

organization.ownerOnly: Only owners can change these settings.
organization.name: Name
organization.timezoneHint: Used for opening hours, peak prices and reports. Example: Africa/Cairo
organization.featuresIntro: Turning a module off hides it everywhere. Its data is kept.

branches.title: Branches
branches.name: Name
branches.activeHint: Closed branches are hidden from the branch switcher. Their history is kept.

staff.title: Staff
staff.inviteIntro: They'll get an email to join. If they already have an account, they'll see the invitation when they open the app.
staff.inviteSaved: Invitation saved. Ask {{email}} to sign in (or create an account) with this email to join.
staff.noBranches: Not assigned to any branch: this person can't work anywhere yet.
staff.removeConfirm: They will lose access to all branches. Their past records are kept.

account.title: Account
account.unsyncedWarning: {{count}} change(s) on this device haven't been uploaded yet and will be lost if you sign out now. Connect to the internet and wait for sync, or sign out anyway.

stationTypes.title: Station types & prices
stationTypes.intro: A station type groups stations with the same prices, e.g. "PS5 Room" or "VIP PC". Each type has its own hourly prices and packages.
stationTypes.ownerOnly: Only owners can change prices. You can view them here.
stationTypes.name: Name
stationTypes.maxPlayersHint: For rooms, prices can depend on how many people play.
stationTypes.activeHint: Turned-off types can't be chosen for new stations. Existing stations and history are kept.

pricing.rulesIntro: Start with a base price for all days and times. Add rules for peak hours, weekends or player counts; when several match, the highest priority wins.
pricing.noRules: No price yet: sessions on this type can't be charged. Add a base price.
pricing.deleteConfirm: Delete this price rule? Bills already made keep their amounts.
pricing.pricePerHourHint: Charged per minute: 30 minutes cost half of this.
pricing.pricePerHourRoomHint: For the whole room, not per player. Charged per minute.
pricing.windowHint: 24-hour clock. If the end is earlier than the start (e.g. 22:00 to 02:00), it runs past midnight and counts as the day it starts.
pricing.playersHint: Leave empty for any number of players.
pricing.priorityHint: When several prices match, the highest number wins. Base price: 0. Peak or weekend: 10.
pricing.validHint: Optional, e.g. for a holiday offer. Leave empty to apply always.
pricing.previewIntro: Try a session and see the price, line by line. Times are in {{timeZone}}.
pricing.previewTooLong: Try a range shorter than 7 days.
pricing.noRate: No price set for this time
pricing.uncoveredWarning: Part of this time has no price, so it is charged 0. Add a base price for all days and times.

packages.title: Hour packages
packages.intro: A fixed price for a number of hours, e.g. 3 hours for 150 EGP. Time after the package is charged at the hourly price.
packages.name: Name
packages.durationHint: e.g. 3:00 for 3 hours, 1:30 for an hour and a half. Up to 24:00.
packages.activeHint: Turned-off packages can't be chosen for new sessions.

stations.title: Stations
stations.empty: No stations in this branch yet.
stations.needTypes: There are no station types yet. Ask the owner to add them.
stations.needTypesOwner: Add a station type first (Settings › Station types & prices).
stations.name: Name or number
stations.countHint: Add several at once: they get numbers after the name.
stations.maintenanceHint: Out of service: it can't be started or booked until you turn this off.
stations.inUseHint: Turn off to remove it from the floor. Its history is kept.
